## The idea

What would you like Juno Bridge to do?

## Why

What workflow does this unblock for you?

## Security considerations

Does this add a new state-changing capability, touch auth, or change what the
browser owner permits? If so, how should the owner stay in control?

> New state-changing commands need a security discussion before
> implementation — see CONTRIBUTING.md.
